config.source:
SELECT 
  p.restaurant_id,
  r.restaurant_name,
  p.total_orders,
  p.revenue,
  p.aov,
  p.unique_customers,
  p.delivery_orders,
  p.eat_in_orders,
  p.avg_rating,
  p.gross_margin,
  p.delivery_share_pct,
  p.gross_margin_pct
FROM restaurant_dev.gold.agg_restaurant_performance p LEFT JOIN restaurant_dev.gold.dim_restaurant r 
  ON p.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id

SELECT 
  year_month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(year_month, 'yyyy-MM')) as year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(year_month, 'yyyy-MM')) as month,
  revenue,
  total_orders,
  unique_customers,
  aov,
  gross_margin_pct
FROM restaurant_dev.gold.agg_revenue_monthly

measures.name: revenue_prev_year
measures.expr:
SUM(CASE 
  WHEN year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
  THEN revenue 
  ELSE 0 
END)

measures.name: total_orders_prev_year
measures.expr:
SUM(CASE 
  WHEN year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
  THEN total_orders 
  ELSE 0 
END)

measures.name: unique_customers_prev_year
measures.expr:
SUM(CASE 
  WHEN year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
  THEN unique_customers 
  ELSE 0 
END)

measures.name: aov_prev_year
measures.expr:
SUM(CASE WHEN year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / 
NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN total_orders ELSE 0 END), 0)

SELECT

  p.total_orders,
  p.unique_customers,
  p.gross_margin
FROM restaurant_dev.gold.agg_restaurant_performance p INNER JOIN restaurant_dev.gold.dim_restaurant r 
  ON p.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id

SELECT 
  p.item_id,
  m.item_name,
  p.category,
  p.sub_category,
  p.units_sold,
  p.times_ordered,
  p.revenue,
  p.margin,
  p.avg_price,
  p.margin_pct
FROM restaurant_dev.gold.agg_item_performance p LEFT JOIN restaurant_dev.gold.dim_menu_item m 
  ON p.item_id = m.item_id

datasets.name: wait_times_raw
queryLines:
SELECT
  average_wait_time_mins
FROM
  fct_daily_ops
WHERE
  average_wait_time_mins IS NOT NULL

measures.name: on_time_deliveries
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: on_time_pct
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(delivery_id)
